spec.kitLine: Activates after firing the last round
spec.assertion: Both S1 buffs appear once per magazine (>=6 in 180s at 6 ammo) and their counts are equal. Nearest-wrong: a shotFired trigger — the patched per-pull run emits >3x as many applications, so the faithful count fails that model.

buffApply stat chargeDamagePct, positive value 37.28, targetSlug eunhwa, durationShots === 2; plus a counterfactual proving it raises eunhwa's total and leaves every teammate byte-identical. Fails under (a) chargeDamageMultPct (stat filter finds 0), (b) durationSec:2 (durationShots undefined), (c) ally/team scoping.

buffApply stat chargeSpeedPct 15.53, self, durationShots === 2; plus total team shot-event count strictly higher than with the buff removed — the weapon-state-is-damage check. Fails if the line is dropped as 'defensive/no damage' or encoded in seconds.

buffApply |value| 29 with targetIdx === null (boss-held), durationShots undefined (seconds, not rounds), and a count exactly equal to the S1 application count — proving both slots share the one last-bullet activation. Fails if scoped to an ally, keyed off a different trigger, or read as a round count.
it.skip — types.ts documents defPct as inert in v1, so no damage delta is observable; taxonomy #7 still requires the stat be encoded, which the event assertions cover.

spec.kitLine: Deals 85.62% of final ATK as damage
spec.assertion: Half/double atkPct counterfactuals (impact count unchanged, so gauge and rotation are identical across runs): base-half > 0 proves the hit exists, and (double-base)/(base-half) === 2 +/-5% proves it is the linear atkPct channel. Fails if the line is missing, folded into a bucket buff, or gated so it never fires.

|value| 2.43, targetIdx === null, exactly one application per cast, and its expiry-frame set is identical to the ally crit buff's — the two 15s lines must share every cast window. Fails on a 10s/round-count read or an ally-scoped target.

Generic critRatePct (NOT critRateNormalPct — the kit has no normal-attack scope clause), applied to every comp member including eunhwa, count === targets x casts, durationShots undefined; removing it strictly lowers BOTH eunhwa's total and the allies' summed total. Fails under excludeSelf, self-only, or a normal-attack-scoped encoding.
it.skip — single partless boss at scope lock, so 1-target vs 10-target multiplicity produces no distinguishable signal in totals or in the events the harness exposes.

fixtures: controlComp('eunhwa', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / eunhwa / helm (B3), boss Fire, focus eunhwa. helm is REQUIRED because a comp with no castable Burst III makes zero Full Bursts. eunhwa is Burst II, so she contends with crown for stage 2; her own 20s cooldown caps her at every other rotation anyway, and with liter's CDR the rotation period is under 20s, so the two B2 units alternate and she casts on roughly half the rotations — the burst group opens with an explicit non-vacuity assertion (>=2 distinct cast windows) so a fixture that starved her would go red rather than silently vacuous. helm's crit line is critRateNormalPct, a different stat key, so it cannot contaminate the critRatePct 4.65 filters. 7 hoisted runs total: base, S1 charge-damage removed, S1 charge-speed removed, S1 trigger swapped to shotFired, burst hit at 0.5x, burst hit at 2x, burst crit removed.
gaps: it.skip — DEF ▼ (S2 29%/5s and burst 2.43%/15s) damage payload: types.ts documents defPct as inert in v1, so only the encoding (boss-held buffApply, magnitude, seconds-not-rounds, cadence) is testable; a strict damage-increase assertion would be unobservable-by-construction.

it.skip — 'Affects 10 enemy unit(s) with the highest final ATK': single partless boss at scope lock makes target multiplicity unobservable; a 10-hit encoding would be indistinguishable from a 1-hit one under totals and under the linearity check.

⚑ Not asserted (outside the input domain): the cadence tuple — reloadFrames 161 / chargeFrames 60 / release latency are datamine-unreliable fields, so every trigger-cadence assertion is written as a RELATIVE comparison (S1 count === S2 count; per-pull run > 3x the per-magazine run) or a loose floor (>=6 magazines), never as an absolute magazine count.
⚑ Not asserted: the sign convention for a ▼ debuff. The kit fixes magnitude and direction but not the encoded sign, so value filters match on |value| and only ▲ buffs are asserted positive.

Not asserted: whether the burst hit crits or takes the Full Burst major — a burst cast lands before the FB window opens (packet rule 9), and RIDERCRIT is a global engine gate, so neither is a per-kit claim the prose supports.
